q: Where are appointments recorded, and how is the booking confirmed to the patient?
a: we have a register at reception, the agent just tells them the day and time on the call. no sms or whatsapp

q: How many patients can each doctor see in a morning or evening slot, and what happens if a slot is full?
a: dont worry about that, reception manages the queue. if they come in their slot they will be seen

q: How should the agent pick the doctor when the caller only describes a problem?
a: child under 14 goes to dr khan, skin hair or nail problems dr iyer, everything else dr mehra

q: What should the agent do in an emergency (chest pain, breathing trouble, heavy bleeding)?
a: tell them to go to the nearest hospital immediately, dont book anything

q: Can patients reschedule or cancel on this call?
a: no, for that they should call the reception during clinic hours

q: What details must be collected besides name, age, doctor and time?
a: nothing else. we already have the number they are calling from

q: Can someone book for another person, like a parent for a child?
a: yes thats common, just take the patients name and age not the callers

q: When should the agent hand over to a person?
a: if they ask for someone at the clinic or ask about reports, test results or medicines. then pass to reception
